# QoreSign

> Hybrid secp256k1 + ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204) signing, verification and Sign In With QoreChain for wallets and backends on QoreChain. TypeScript, Rust, Go, Swift, Kotlin, Python. Apache-2.0.

Lanes: native (Cosmos SDK) = hybrid signing, required by the network by default; EVM = quantum-ready mode only (registered ML-DSA-87 key + authorization window opened from the native lane); SVM = not open yet.
Networks: mainnet chain id qorechain-vladi (REST https://api.qore.host), testnet qorechain-diana (REST https://api-testnet.qore.host). Bech32 prefix qor, coin type 118 (eth-native accounts: 60), fee denom uqor (6 decimals), minimum gas price 0.1 uqor.

## Specs
- [Hybrid transaction signing v1](spec/hybrid-signing-v1.md): extension /qorechain.pqc.v1.PQCHybridSignature, sign-bytes v1/v2, order of operations, MsgRegisterPQCKeyV2 + proof of possession
- [Sign In With QoreChain v1](spec/siwq-v1.md)
- [Message signing v1](spec/message-signing-v1.md): ADR-36 + ML-DSA-87 over "qorechain-msg-v1|" + chainId + "|" + data; reserved signing domains
- [ML-DSA-87 key derivation](spec/hd-derivation-draft.md): canonical SHAKE256 derivation (stable), hardened-only HD (draft)
- [Test vectors](vectors/README.md)

## API (TypeScript, @qorechain/qoresign)
- deriveClassicalKey, deriveCanonicalPqKey, deriveHdPqKey, addressFromPublicKey, parseAddress
- signHybrid, signPqLayer, hybridSignBytes, verifyHybridTx, verifyPqLayer
- buildRegisterPqKeyMessage, signProofOfPossession, verifyProofOfPossession
- createSiwqMessage, parseSiwqMessage, signSiwq, verifySiwq
- signMessage, verifyMessage, messagePqSignBytes, RESERVED_PQ_DOMAINS
- assertHybridLane, decideLane, evaluateLayerState
- @qorechain/qoresign/network: fetchPqKeyStatus, resolveSignBytesVersion, simulateTx, broadcastTx, submitWithSignBytesFallback, assertPqLayerMatchesRegisteredKey, verifySiwqWithChain, verifyMessageWithChain
- Errors: QoreSignError with a stable `code` (e.g. PQ_SIGNATURE_INVALID, KEY_NOT_REGISTERED, LANE_NOT_AVAILABLE, SIMULATION_FAILED)

## Other packages
- Rust: crate qorechain-qoresign (crates/qoresign), same names in snake_case
- Go: github.com/qorechain/qoresign/go, includes network helpers
- Swift (QoreSign), Kotlin (io.github.qorechain:qoresign), Python (pip install qorechain-qoresign, import qoresign): offline bindings over the Rust crate, no network helpers. Python names are snake_case (derive_classical_key, sign_hybrid, verify_siwq, ...); errors raise qoresign.QoreSignError with .code and .detail
- [Python README](python/README.md)

## Examples
- [examples](examples/README.md): derive-and-verify (offline), register-and-send (testnet), siwq-server (testnet)
